_doc: Thresholds for tools/art/art_validator.py. Each check has warn/fail levels. Do not loosen a threshold to make art pass; fix the art, or document a justified change in docs/ART_PIPELINE.md.
license: Original procedural asset generated by Forgebound pipeline (CC0-like project-owned)

budget._doc: Raised in regeneration batch 2 from 30/40 MB: the asset count grew from 450 to ~1,550 files (every runtime lookup now has art) and the project budget for committed art is ~60 MB (Generated PNGs + atlases).

qualitative_checkpoints: Silhouette: each Frame reads as its weapon class from silhouette alone (fill shapes black and compare).
Core identity: each Core is recognisable by gem SHAPE as well as colour (check in greyscale / colour-blind simulation).
Value structure: clear light/shadow split, no muddy mid-tone soup; key light from upper-left on everything.
Hand-painted feel: painted-noise breakup visible but not dirty; outlines even and not broken.
Tier read: tier 3 visibly richer than tier 1 (gold trim, ornaments) without becoming noisy.
Legendary read: unique accent silhouette + glow layer feels special yet the Frame is still identifiable.
Animation: idle loops without a pop between last and first frame; attack has clear anticipation, impact and recovery.
In-context: view sprites over the actual battle backgrounds and UI panels at phone scale (48-64 px icons).
Style consistency: weapons, board pieces and characters look like one game (same outline weight, light rig, palette).
Originality: no resemblance to existing game IP (shapes, emblems, characters).
_doc_unframed: Single-image categories carry no _NN frame suffix: the runtime resolves them by exact name (SpriteLibrary.Icon -> fb_<cat>_<id>_icon, BattleWorld -> fb_env_<biome>_bg).

category_rules._doc: Per-category overrides. env backgrounds are full-frame opaque paintings: transparency, border, crop, halo, sprite-contrast and phone-legibility checks do not apply to them, RGB (no alpha) is allowed and the per-file budget is raised for a 1920x1080 image. All other categories use the global thresholds.

_doc_duplicate_exempt_ids: Ids whose sprites may be byte/near-identical copies by design (e.g. shared training-dummy art). Empty: batch 2 renders a distinct variant per training dummy instead of copies.
